state_at_amendment: No dev_sel2000, dev or test score of any arm of this experiment has been computed by this track. No G_k or GU_k adapter has been trained (only the registered 50-step benchmark adapters, deleted after the throughput runs). No test generation exists. The only use of answers: train answers of the 1,300 benchmark questions (outside every training list) as benchmark LoRA targets, and reader_train60k (the registered k = 100 LLM list) bundle targets for token counts only. A local plumbing test of the session script used a dev file whose answers had been replaced by a placeholder string (no real dev answer read; all its scores are 0 by construction).

prompts.G_HEAD:
Answer the temporal question about the ICEWS knowledge graph. An automatic pipeline has parsed the question, retrieved supporting facts and ranked candidate answers. Its output may be wrong: check it against the facts and give a different answer when the facts support one.
Reply with the answer only: one entity name exactly as written, or a date written YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
prompts.GU_HEAD:
Answer the temporal question about the ICEWS knowledge graph using the retrieved facts below.
Reply with the answer only: one entity name exactly as written, or a date written YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
prompts.G_layout: question; Parse (entities with up to 2 alternatives, top relation hypothesis + answer role, qtype/operator, answer type, granularity, time constraint, anchor); Candidates in the selected order, one line each: candidate | RULE rank | S score | satisfies operator | supporting fact groups; Facts F1.. grouped losslessly by (subject, relation, object), groups in first-appearance order, dates chronological; Operator trace. The parse is labelled as possibly wrong and the model is told it may answer differently (rule: may override the parse and the candidates)
prompts.GU_layout: question; the 20 retrieved facts in retrieval order, one per line (subject | relation | object | date); no parse, candidates, scores, trace
prompts.SHUF: own question + the whole bundle of the deranged donor question (default_rng(0) permutation over the split's sorted quids, fixed points swapped with the next index)

implementation_details.chat_template: Llama-3.1 template, one user turn, date_string fixed to '26 Jul 2024' (the template otherwise inserts the run date), identical at training and inference
implementation_details.candidate_order_tie: G_1 order selection: random order is chosen only if its selected-checkpoint dev_sel2000 Hits@1 exceeds the S-order one by >= 0.0005; otherwise S order
implementation_details.checkpoint_tie: best dev_sel2000 Hits@1, tie (equal hit count) -> earlier checkpoint (rule)
implementation_details.answer_canonicalisation: an output valid by the rule's normalisation (strip, whitespace collapse, case fold, _ -> space) is written as the KG entity name it matches (KG names in space form; 0 normalisation collisions among 10,488 entities); valid time strings are kept; invalid outputs stay at rank 1 unchanged
implementation_details.training: micro-batches under an 8,192 padded-token limit inside each effective batch of 16 questions; per-epoch permutation default_rng(1000*seed + 7 + epoch), length-sorted within chunks of 64 batches, batch order shuffled within chunk; loss = summed answer-token cross-entropy / answer tokens of the effective batch; lm_head evaluated only at answer positions; adapter saved at every epoch end (and at 0.5 epoch when E_max = 1); resume checkpoint every 500 steps; all questions of the list trained (target fallback answers[0] as registered)
implementation_details.truncation: if prompt + answer > 2,048 tokens, trailing fact groups are dropped (G/SHUF) or trailing facts (GU); 0 of 60,001 k100 train prompts needed it (max 1,484 tokens)
implementation_details.sessions: one vLLM session per arm: all checkpoints on dev_sel2000 -> official-scorer selection (logged as computed) -> freeze file with adapter / prompt / code / bundle sha256 written BEFORE any test prompt -> test predictions written, sha256 added, not scored; G_1 session also runs SHUF_G1 and QONLY_G1 on dev_sel2000 and test
implementation_details.ranked_lists: G family: [answer] + S_k seed-0 list (structural track prediction file); bundle candidates in S order if that file is absent. GU: [answer] + entities and dates of the retrieved facts (dates at the answer's granularity when it is a time string), deduplicated, padded to 20 with the 50 most frequent answers of the k% list
implementation_details.gu_retriever: registered recipe; passages '<h> <r with _ -> space> <t> on <date>' in kg/full.txt order (CSV-unquoted), fp16 bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings normalised; score = inner product; top-20, ties by fact index. The 461,329-fact index embedded during the stage-0 run (sha256 fd749ec7...) is the A2 index (same code and model)
implementation_details.gu_recall_diagnostic: recall@20 of a gold-supporting fact on dev_sel2000 NOT computed: the rule's dev_rule allows dev_sel2000 answers for selection, early stopping and thresholds only

k100_bundles.what: gk_convert_k100.py converts the frozen k = 100 exports (parser outputs, S_seed0 top-20 blocks re-scored by the reader track, top-50 RULE rank and operator features, top-20 provenance facts) into the bundle schema; operator trace synthesised from the frozen parse and S features; dev/test carry no gold and no label column is read
k100_bundles.use: script development now; for G_100 these bundles are used unless the structural track stages its own k100 bundles before G_100 training (decision recorded before G_100 training)

implementation_details.vllm_70b: TP2 requires disable_custom_all_reduce=True on these PCIe cards (first attempt hung); relevant to P_0 (LLM-parser track)
